I cut the green cards and Traitorous Blood, Curse of the Pierced Heart and Charmbreaker Devils to fit 23 spells. Lands are 10 Mountain and 7 Plains because red has the heavier pips.

…deck with removal (Claustrophobia, Sensory Deprivation, Ghostly Possession, Rebuke, Smite) and fliers (Stitched Drake x2, Murder of Crows, Geist, Voiceless Spirit). Cut the weaker blue spells, Curiosity, Wooden Stake and the second Moment of Heroism to keep 23 playables with 17 lands.

…Travel Preparations, Blazing Torch and Feeling of Dread as interaction, and Geistcatcher's Rig as an answer to fliers. Cut Caravan Vigil, Naturalize, Full Moon's Rise, Spare from Evil, Inquisitor's Flail, Traveler's Amulet and shimmering lands; 17 basics, Forest-heavy for the GG/GGG costs.

Black-green midrange: removal (Victim of Night, Prey Upon, Corpse Lunge), Garruk Relentless, and a curve of creatures with Curse of Death's Hold and big green top end. Cut the red, blue, white cards and the weaker Gnaw/Cellar Door/Skeletal Grimace filler; 17 lands including Woodland Cemetery.
